text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky seems to have lost her 
motivation lately. A concerned Trainer 
tries to talk things over with her, only 
to get stood up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together with a worried King Halo, the 
Trainer visited Seiun Sky. However, she 
simply stated, "I'm tired of racing 
already."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
King Halo fumes with anger. Even though 
she finally found her own path thanks to 
Seiun Sky's words, "Mastering the 
unconventional makes it the orthodox 
path"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Saying she was disappointed in him, King 
Halo walked away. Seiun Sky asked his 
Trainer to leave him alone for now.
